title: Run Lamp Test From VISU_MANCONTROL and Verify Red Flash + Audible Alarm
summary: On the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL, use the LAMP TEST button to verify the audible alarm sounds and the stacklight flashes red.
when_to_use: Use to confirm the VISU_MANCONTROL LAMP TEST function triggers both the audible alarm and the stacklight red flashing behavior.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the VISU_MANCONTROL lamp test and verify audible + visual outcomes.
L2_support (as needed): Stop and escalate if either the audible alarm or red flashing stacklight does not occur.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU access to the VISU_MANCONTROL screen
Audible and visual access to the stacklight

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the LAMP TEST button and its item description (Item 5: audible alarm + stacklight flashes red).

steps.title: Open the VISU_MANCONTROL screen
steps.purpose: Access the maintenance manual control screen that contains the LAMP TEST button.
steps.instruction: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed with the LAMP TEST button visible.
steps.healthy_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL is loaded and the LAMP TEST button is present on the screen.
steps.failure_condition: VISU_MANCONTROL does not load or the LAMP TEST button is not visible.
stop_or_escalate_if: If VISU_MANCONTROL cannot be opened or the LAMP TEST button is not available, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: VISU_MANCONTROL screen item description includes Item 5: The LAMP TEST button will sound the audible alarm and the stacklight will flash red.

steps.title: Press LAMP TEST
steps.purpose: Trigger the lamp test behavior defined for VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.instruction: On the VISU_MANCONTROL screen, press the LAMP TEST button.
steps.expected_result: After pressing LAMP TEST, the audible alarm sounds and the stacklight flashes red.
steps.healthy_condition: Audible alarm is heard and the stacklight flashes red.
steps.failure_condition: Audible alarm does not sound and/or the stacklight does not flash red.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the audible alarm does not sound.
Stop and escalate if the stacklight does not flash red.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Item 5: The LAMP TEST button will sound the audible alarm and the stacklight will flash red.
Figure 4-23 item description: LAMP TEST button functionality (audible alarm, red stacklight).
VISU_MANCONTROL includes LAMP TEST button behavior: audible alarm + stacklight flashes red.

success_criteria: Audible alarm sounds after pressing LAMP TEST.
Stacklight flashes red after pressing LAMP TEST.
healthy_conditions: Audible alarm is heard during the lamp test.
Stacklight flashes red during the lamp test.
failure_conditions: Audible alarm does not sound after pressing LAMP TEST.
Stacklight does not flash red after pressing LAMP TEST.
escalation_guidance: If either the audible alarm does not sound or the stacklight does not flash red, stop the test and escalate.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Item 5: The LAMP TEST button will sound the audible alarm and the stacklight will flash red.

missing_details: The source does not specify which stacklight (e.g., left vs right) is used for the lamp test; the procedure assumes the corresponding stacklight associated with the manual control station.
